items.title: Generator-based delooping constructions for presented groups in homotopy type theory
items.author: Camil Champin; Samuel Mimram; Émile Oleon
items.source_version: Author publication-page-linked conference full version arXiv2405.03264v1 (2024-05-06), native TeX with complete proof appendix, retrieved2026-10-13; own arXivv1 license CC BY4.0
items.difficulty_reason: The authors reconstruct a group delooping from generating loops/relations and alternatively recover the full torsor loop group from restricted generator actions. The proofs use higher-inductive inverse maps, quotient descent and nontrivial transport identities. Both constructions have the same delooping purpose and are grouped into one count.
